Modelled natural river flow: GEOGLOWS v2 (ECMWF runoff routed on TDX-Hydro rivers), big rivers only. The model leaves out dams and withdrawals such as India's Farakka Barrage, so the real Ganges inflow is lower, most of all in the dry season. Rain: CHIRPS v3 satellite and gauge pentads. Dots show the mix of water, not its travel time.
